answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in grove, expire in meadow, and thread lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 113 aliases as a result needs 127 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 91 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
